text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, during training—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...It's gotten into a rut.
Continuing tests like this will yield the same results for a while."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If we want to change our approach,
I'd like to gather new data around here
and integrate it into our routine, but—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Of all days, the course had to be reserved today, huh?
Dammit, I can't gather any data like this.
choice_data_list: Wanna go check out the racetrack or something?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"It's doable, but the travel time's a waste.
Just hold on a sec."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Guess this is good enough.
choice_data_list: "The taiyaki inside the station is super delicious"...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The message was sent to the Ritto Dorm group chat.
It looks like meaningless small talk, but what on earth could it mean...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Shut up and you'll see.
Let's kill some time with basic training.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, courtesy of Spe-chan,
let's kick off our Taiyaki Tea Party!”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh, my precious taiyaki...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped, Spe-chan.
Even if you got lured in by Shakur's post,
you bought a bit too much...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If I'd eaten it all by myself...
I probably would have gained a ton of weight.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Spe-chan,
for eating your taiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai!
No, I'm the one who asked you for this!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Really? But I think a tea party was a wonderful idea.
Look, everyone seems so happy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Even if we can only have a little,
I thought eating together would be fun
and make us feel full... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
That truly was a delicious taiyaki...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I ended up getting completely dragged into this, but... oh well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Still, I ended up taking in more calories than expected.
I have to make up for it somehow...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then!
How about we all train together? ☆

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that... sounds nice.
Going for a run should help digest our food, too."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm!
It's delicious, and it counts as training...
Taiyaki really is Mahrvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hmm, if I'm gonna run, maybe having one more would've been fine...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You never learn, do you...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: All right!! I'm gonna run a whole bunch and deliver the Marvelous to everyone~☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's a wonderful spirit, but
don't forget your warm-up exercises!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After waiting with Air Shakur for a little while—for some reason, Umamusume had been steadily gathering around the training track for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ha, look at that puzzled face.
It's like they say: 'When the wind blows, the barrel makers prosper.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...In other words, you are saying that the message sent earlier triggered a crowd of Umamusume to come here?
choice_data_list: Now we can do all kinds of training!
Now we can do all sorts of training!
Her perspective is completely out of the ordinary...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah?
Don't tell me you're thinking we're gonna hold hands and train together... or some crap like that?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Think efficiently.
Keeping the message to a single line was for efficiency, too. If this many Umamusume are gathered here—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
――Rather than dealing with them one by one,
it's more efficient to gather data from a birds-eye view.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Folks who don't usually run together
are all gathered in one place.
They'll make for fine test subjects.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, you keep your eyes peeled too, bastard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm no match for Air Shakur's intellect...
This incident served as a stark reminder of that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Probably. But once you break it down into numbers, it's a method anyone could come up with.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whining that it's unrealistic or reckless...
People who grumble like that are just crushing
their own options with their own hands.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch, I talked too much. More importantly—hm?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? You look like you're having fun...
Do you want to run here?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, turning off the path so suddenly...
what's the matter, Cafe—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, how curious. So many Umamusume training all at once... I'd better observe this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Oi oi, I didn't invite those guys...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, well...
it's still a golden chance to collect data.
You better keep your eyes peeled too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was a moment that made me marvel once again
at Air Shakur's brilliant mind...!"
